text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
drawing near, Matikanefukukitaru was asked 
by Silence Suzuka, "Are you happy right 
now?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Fukukitaru answered the 
question: she is truly "happy" right now, 
able to run with all her might thanks to 
her Trainer and fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then, she turned the tables, asking 
Silence Suzuka if she herself was happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka answered. She isn't 
completely happy yet. However, she feels 
she is close to grasping it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru and Silence Suzuka 
moved forward along their own paths, each 
seeking their own form of happiness.
